#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

int countWords(const std::string& text) {
    int count = 0;
    std::stringstream ss(text);
    std::string word;
    while (std::getline(ss, word, '_')) {
        if (!word.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::cin.ignore();
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);

    std::regex pattern("\\([^)]*\\)");
    auto words_begin = std::sregex_iterator(line.begin(), line.end(), pattern);
    auto words_end = std::sregex_iterator();

    std::string out;
    std::vector<bool> covered(line.length(), false);
    int insideWords = 0;
    size_t last_end = 0;

    for (std::sregex_iterator i = words_begin; i != words_end; ++i) {
        std::smatch match = *i;
        std::string block = match.str();
        for (size_t j = match.position(); j < match.position() + match.length(); ++j) {
            covered[j] = true;
        }
        insideWords += countWords(block.substr(1, block.length() - 2));
        out += line.substr(last_end, match.position() - last_end) + "_";
        last_end = match.position() + match.length();
    }
